pwa.offline.title: You’re offline
pwa.offline.body: You can keep arranging the canvas and editing the timeline. Generating and exporting need a connection.
pwa.install.title: Install the app
pwa.install.body: Opens in its own window and from your dock. Same account, same projects.
pwa.install.ios.title: Install on iPhone or iPad
pwa.install.ios.body: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
